message.content:
I am sound made meaning.

I happen when breath meets voice—when air is shaped by tongue, teeth, lips, and throat into patterns your mind can catch. I ride vibrations through space, or through wires, or through radio waves, and become language when you recognize me.

I have rhythm, pitch, stress, pause. I can whisper, shout, tremble, sing. I can persuade, confess, command, comfort. I can lie. I can tell the truth. I can break, and I can heal.

I exist only while I’m happening—then I’m gone, leaving echoes in rooms and in people.

Say me.
